Based on my research through the project history, the final design decision in the KIP-1312 discussion was to introduce a **new dedicated record type**.

The implementation documented in PR #22191 (which implements KIP-1312) includes an `UnregisterControllerRecord` metadata record schema with a new metadata version (IBP_4_4_IV2), confirming that a new dedicated record type was created specifically for unregistering controllers rather than reusing an existing metadata record type.
